description: Use when planning or executing a migration from change-set-based deployments to Salesforce DX source-driven development. Trigger keywords: 'migrate from change sets', 'move to SFDX', 'convert metadata to source format'. NOT for greenfield SFDX project setup (use sf-cli-and-sfdx-essentials), unlocked package — use apex/sf-cli-and-sfdx-essentials.
inputs: inventory of metadata types currently promoted via change sets (Apex, Flows, Custom Objects, etc.)
source org alias or username authenticated with sf CLI
whether the org already has a connected git repository or version control system
team size and current release cadence (weekly, biweekly, ad hoc)
target end state: manifest-based deploys, unlocked packages, or DevOps Center
name: migration-from-change-sets-to-sfdx
official_sources: Salesforce DX Developer Guide, Project Configuration (sfdx_dev.txt L2291–2300 sample sfdx-project.json; L2335–2344 packageDirectories required, relative paths, exactly one default when several; L2410–2418 sourceApiVersion decides retrieved fields), Convert Files in Metadata Format (L2074–2085), profiles recommendation (L11884–11887); Metadata API Developer Guide, InstalledPackage (api_meta.txt L81389–81395). Supports references/project-config-worked-example.md and the checker.
Salesforce DX Developer Guide: Source Format — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.sfdx_dev.meta/sfdx_dev/sfdx_dev_source_file_format.htm
Salesforce DX Developer Guide: Migrate Existing Source — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/sfcli/guide/project-convert-mdapi.html

Salesforce DX Developer Guide, Summer '26 PDF (sfdx_dev.txt): `retrieve start --manifest` writes source format into `force-app` L2024–2035; `sf project generate manifest --from-org` L2045–2047; convert ignores dot-files and `.forceignore` matches L2066–2084; `sourceApiVersion` L2408–2416; profile retrieval and the permission-set recommendation L11881–11889; source tracking in Developer / Developer Pro sandboxes L989–995. Supports Pattern 1 and Gotchas 1, 2, 3, 6.

Metadata API Developer Guide (api_meta.txt): Profile retrieve contents L98477–98484 and standard-object permissions not overwritten unless included L98502–98506; flow file names without versions and FlowDefinition precedence L73195–73200; Pre/Post destructive manifests L4648–4660. Supports Gotchas 3, 4, 5.
outputs: migration plan with phased component conversion sequence
SFDX project directory with converted source-format metadata
package.xml manifest covering the migrated component set
decision guidance on target deployment model (manifest vs. packages vs. DevOps Center)
